packageRules.description: compat-bump.yml's daily run and compat/bump-manifest.mjs move compat/manifest.json and the COUPLED_PINS pins together, so a Renovate bump that moved one without the other would open a PR that can never go green. fixtures/package.json's @e4a/pg-wasm pin is deliberately uncoupled so it ages against the corpus, and the corpus writer crates' exact pg-core pins under fixtures-verify are append-only history.
